column1: # custom-rules: a rule set ktrs can't run natively hands the task to the ktlint jar's CLI, whose --format reports only
# what it could not fix: no "Format fixed > [rule]" rows and no "<file>: Format fixed" line (research/34, deviations).
# The formatted sources, the lint rows and the reports are the same.
# tools/kotlinter/real.sh, kotlinter's own test-project (its `rules` rule set): the same hand-off. Nothing but fixed
# rows was reported there, so upstream's test-format.txt lists them and ours says `ok`.
